text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error rate and p99 latency on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Error rate 18% (threshold 5%), p99 latency 3.2s. Alert INC-2026-1942. Linked logs: https://console.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-1942

sasha: I'm oncall, taking this. Paging in progress — will triage live. Anyone on the rollout?

maria: I kicked off a small pilot earlier at 03:10 UTC, rolling redwood/infer-model:v2.2.0 to 5% of traffic (pilot ring). Observing increased 500s in pilot cluster. Suspect rollout correlation.

sasha: okay, can you paste the canary diff / request success rates?

maria: quick numbers from our canary dashboard:
- ring: v2.1.3 (stable) -> success 99.7%
- ring: v2.2.0 (pilot) -> success 81.6%
- error class: tokenization/decode errors ~72% of pilot 500s

leo: infra metrics: memory on pilot nodes spiked by ~40% coincident with pilot roll. No node OOMs. GPU utilization normal. Network retransmits small bump.

akshay: I'm pulling logs now. Will share tail.

akshay: log snippet from a failing request (shortened):
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T03:12:04Z inference-service: decode failed: tokenizer: unknown token sequence "\uFFFD" -> returning 500
trace_id=abc123 user_id=acct-556 model=v2.2.0
stack: github.com/redwood/infer/decoder.Decode -> runtime/panic -> http.Handler
```

maria: that's the tokenizer mismatch I was worried about. v2.2.0 updated sentencepiece model, but our serving layer forgot to bundle the matching tokenizer artifact in the container image. Oops.

sasha: hypothesis list (tracking in-thread):
1) tokenizer artifact missing/bad in v2.2.0 image -> decode errors for some inputs (high confidence)
2) runtime change in kernel selection triggered regressions under certain seq-len (medium)
3) unrelated infra/network blip causing transient failures (low)

maria: confirming: image manifest for v2.2.0 shows tokenizer path /opt/model/tokenizer is empty. i.e. missing files. Repro: pulled image locally and ran a small sample -> same decode errors.

leo: rolling policy check: pilot at 5% traffic via ring router. We can immediately stop routing to pilot and run a rollback. Capacity should be fine for stable.

sasha: customer impact assessment: hosted API customers in us-west-2 experiencing degraded quality; small % of customers hit errors (estimated 2.7% of total requests in region). No outage to account-level auth or console. We should open an incident page and update status page.

june: I'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb for status page: "We are investigating increased errors for text generation in US-West. Affected requests may return 500. We're rolling back a recent model pilot while we investigate."

sasha: decide rollback? We should stop pilot routing, roll inference-service back to v2.1.3, and pin traffic until we confirm fix. Any objections?

maria: +1. Also want to capture a post-rollout diff artifact and keep the v2.2.0 image quarantined for further analysis.

deploy-bot: Action: create rollback release -> executing: 
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-service inference=redwood/infer-model:v2.1.3 --record
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-service -n inference
```
deploy-bot: Rollback started at 03:20 UTC. Rollout progress: 3/3 pods updated.

akshay: verifying logs post-rollback: success rate trending back up. Pilot 500s drop to baseline within ~90s of rollback.

leo: console confirms traffic rebalanced. No further elevated node memory trends.

sasha: decision log: rolled back pilot to v2.1.3 at 03:20 UTC. Pinned routing to stable. v2.2.0 flagged as quarantined-image for investigation.

maria: next steps for ML: reproduce locally, attach tokenizer artifact to image, add CI check to validate tokenizer present, and run a small canary smoke test before ring routing.

akshay: ops tasks: add a temporary alert rule for tokenizer decode error rate (distinct from generic 500s) and run a full grep for similar errors in last 72h. Sharing quick grep: 
```
grep -R "tokenizer: unknown token sequence" /var/logs/inference | wc -l -> 47 matches in last 30m (all in pilot nodes)
```

june: communications: status page posted, support notified for potential customer tickets, incident post created.

sasha: handing over to akshay for monitoring and follow-up. I'll jump back for the postmortem. akshay — can you own the incident until EOD?

akshay: on it. I'll monitor for 2 hours then hand to next oncall. Summary for handoff: rollback at 03:20 UTC, root cause likely missing tokenizer artifact in v2.2.0 image, customer impact limited to 2–3% of requests in us-west-2, mitigation: rollback and pin, next actions: image fix + CI guard + postmortem with timeline.

sasha: thanks team. Tagging action owners: maria (ml fix + image), leo (routing / infra check), akshay (monitor + alerts), june (communication). I'll author the in-incident timeline for the RCA thread. :thumbsup:

[END THREAD]
